project.description: Configure the PIC-SURE Logging Service API key. Reads the key from logging.env and propagates it to the services that use the logging client.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
LOGGING_ENV="/usr/local/docker-config/logging/logging.env"
if [ ! -f "$LOGGING_ENV" ]; then echo "No logging.env found at $LOGGING_ENV - skipping." exit 0 fi
NEW_API_KEY=$(grep '^LOGGING_API_KEY=' "$LOGGING_ENV" | cut -d= -f2-) if [ -z "$NEW_API_KEY" ]; then echo "LOGGING_API_KEY not set in $LOGGING_ENV - skipping." exit 0 fi
# Propagate the key to every service that ships the logging client. WildFly used to be the only # consumer (via standalone.xml); the gateway is now, and it reads LOGGING_API_KEY straight from # its environment. Add-or-replace so a gateway.env generated without the line still gets it. # '|' delimiter: the key is hex, but the old value may be anything. GATEWAY_ENV="/usr/local/docker-config/gateway/gateway.env"
if [ ! -f "$GATEWAY_ENV" ]; then echo "No gateway.env found at $GATEWAY_ENV - nothing to propagate to." exit 0 fi
CURRENT=$(grep '^LOGGING_API_KEY=' "$GATEWAY_ENV" | cut -d= -f2-) if [ "$CURRENT" = "$NEW_API_KEY" ]; then echo "Logging API key already up to date in gateway.env." exit 0 fi
if grep -q '^LOGGING_API_KEY=' "$GATEWAY_ENV"; then sed -i "s|^LOGGING_API_KEY=.*|LOGGING_API_KEY=$NEW_API_KEY|" "$GATEWAY_ENV" else echo "LOGGING_API_KEY=$NEW_API_KEY" >> "$GATEWAY_ENV" fi
echo "gateway.env updated -- recreate the gateway container (Deploy or Start PIC-SURE) to apply."
